body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony presented ''K790a'', its 3.2M Cyber-shot mobile phone during CES 2007, which features a mobile blogging function. So, you can take pictures and upload the photos to your blog directly or you can share the images with others through email or MMS.
If you have a printer with PictBridge printing support with you, you can print them without the need for a pc. You can also edit the images on the mobile phone.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
